title: Shape Test

serves.summary: Kindergarten: the child tests solid shapes (sphere, cube, box, cylinder, cone) on a ramp and under a block, turning them onto flat or curved faces, then sorts them into rolls, slides or stacks by what each test showed.

request.topic: Solid shapes that roll, slide and stack
request.objective: Find which solid shapes roll, slide and stack by testing them, and use the flat and curved faces to explain why.

problems.ask: Test both shapes on the ramp. Put each one in the box for what it did: rolls or slides.
problems.goal: Both tested on the ramp; the sphere in Rolls, the cube in Slides. Both go down the ramp, so going down is not rolling: only the sphere turns over as it goes.

cube on its flat face, on the ramp: slid
sphere on its curved surface, on the ramp: rolled
cube on its flat face, on the ramp: slid

problems.ask: Test each shape on the ramp the way it is sitting. Sort them: rolls or slides.
problems.goal: All four tested as they sit. Sphere in Rolls; cube, standing cylinder and cone on its base in Slides.

problems.ask: Find out which shapes can roll. Sort them: can roll or cannot roll.
problems.goal: Sphere, cylinder and cone in Can roll, each seen rolling (cylinder and cone only roll on their curved side); cube in Cannot roll after a test.

problems.ask: Find out which shapes can hold the red block on top. Sort them: stacks or does not stack.
problems.goal: Cube, box and cylinder (standing on its flat face) in Stacks, each seen holding the block; sphere and cone in Does not stack after a test.
